deals_control.event: GMFI transfers shares to Danantara as an in-specie dividend
deals_control.headline: GMFI transfers 82.1 billion shares to Danantara as in-specie dividend
deals_control.blurb: Garuda Maintenance Facility deposited the dividend on 2 November, transferring shares previously held by Angkasa Pura Indonesia through InJourney to Danantara Asset Management. The shares have a nominal value of Rp1.55 trillion, giving Danantara a 65.77% stake, while control remains indirectly with the Indonesian government through BP BUMN.

deals_control.event: Nawasena agrees to acquire control of Idea Indonesia Akademi
deals_control.headline: Nawasena agrees to acquire 66.58% of IDEA
deals_control.blurb: Nawasena signed a conditional agreement on 2 November to buy 707.32 million Idea Indonesia Akademi shares from Eko Desriyanto and Idea Asia Investama. Completion remains subject to the agreement’s conditions, after which Nawasena must make a mandatory tender offer to public shareholders.

deals_control.event: LAPD shareholders appoint JSI Sinergi Mas as controller and approve capital increase
deals_control.headline: LAPD appoints JSI Sinergi Mas controller with 51% stake, approves capital increase
deals_control.blurb: At its 29 October meeting, shareholders approved raising authorized capital from Rp1.5 trillion to Rp1.6 trillion and a second rights issue with new Series B shares at a nominal Rp25 each. Existing shares will be designated Series A, and Bambang Rahardja Burhan resigned as director effective from the meeting.

earnings_guidance.event: Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo turns profitable in nine-month 2026 results
earnings_guidance.headline: RMKO turns profitable with Rp1.2 billion 9M net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo’s 9M revenue rose 57.4% to Rp345.3 billion, while EBITDA reached Rp59.4 billion from a Rp9.3 billion loss a year earlier. A rights issue completed on 21 July raised Rp114.3 billion, cutting debt-to-equity from 0.54x to 0.19x and financial debt by 40.6% to Rp56.7 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Kiwoom Sekuritas revises its target price for Bank Central Asia
earnings_guidance.headline: Kiwoom revises BBCA’s 12-month target price
earnings_guidance.blurb: Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia updated its target after a valuation review, citing solid fundamentals. BCA reported nine-month net profit of Rp45.2 trillion, up 4.2% year on year, while loans grew 12.6% to Rp1,063.1 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Sariguna Primatirta reports Q3 sales growth and sets full-year target
earnings_guidance.headline: CLEO reports Q3 sales up 25.5% and targets double-digit 2026 growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sariguna Primatirta’s bottle segment, 56.9% of sales, grew 29.7% to Rp1.5 trillion, while net profit rose 23.6% to Rp377.1 billion. It plans to start operating plants in Pekanbaru and Pontianak by year-end and targets a higher circular-packaging share than the 18% recorded in 2025.

earnings_guidance.event: Surya Semesta Internusa reports nine-month 2026 results
earnings_guidance.headline: SSIA reports 9M26 revenue up 44.7% to Rp4.81 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Surya Semesta’s net profit reached Rp344.4 billion, versus Rp6.5 billion a year earlier, while EBITDA rose 270.6% to Rp951.5 billion and its margin expanded to 19.8% from 7.7%. Property and hotel revenue climbed 172.2% and 161.2%, respectively, while construction revenue fell 5.4% to Rp2.51 trillion amid lower new contract acquisitions.
